fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Timezone: an IANA name (e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London", or `cities[0].timezone` from /location/search) or decimal hours from UTC (e.g. -5 for EST, 5.5 for IST). An IANA name is resolved to the offset in force at the given date and time.

fields.name: planets
fields.description: Optional: specific bodies to calculate aspects for (defaults to all 14: the 10 classical planets, the lunar nodes, Chiron, and Black Moon Lilith)

fields.name: aspectTypes
fields.description: Optional: specific aspect types to find (defaults to all 9)
